name: Configuration and Bootstrap
description: Defines embedded etcd defaults, flag and file loading, validation, TLS, discovery, and cluster bootstrap behavior.

name: Logging and Tracing
description: Constructs zap logging, platform-specific journal outputs, log rotation, and OpenTelemetry tracing for the embedded server.

name: Embedded Server Runtime
description: Starts and stops the embedded member, creates listeners, serves gRPC and HTTP traffic, and coordinates gateways and shutdown.

name: Package Support
description: Documents the embedding API, detects persisted WAL state during startup, and stores graph-generation preferences.

name: Integration and Configuration Tests
description: Exercises embedded startup, authentication, configuration validation, tracing, metrics listeners, bootstrap errors, and reusable network fixtures.
